summary: Twelve selected items sit within the 7-12 target. The set is thematically strong but concentrated: two items cover the HuggingFace/OpenAI autonomous-breakout story (CNN report, adversariel insider context) and two cover AI-driven math breakthroughs (Qiaoqiao2001 Erdos, mattshumer conjecture). The Moonshot distillation allegation (mkratsios47) is well-balanced by its rebuttal (ChrisGPT). All selected items carry named authors and source URLs, so no source-traceability failures. The main change: the mattshumer conjecture tweet is vague, unsourced commentary that overlaps the concrete Qiaoqiao2001 Erdos result; recommend replacing it with eligible reserve 0xYaros (Dario Amodei AGI/coding-automation timelines) for a distinct forecasting angle. Set-level flags note the same-topic clusters.
